Cytochalasin B inhibits actin polymerization by binding to the plus end of actin filaments, which are microfilaments.  
Microspikes of the growth cone contain actin microfilaments, not microtubules, so (A) and (B) are incorrect.  
Cytochalasin B causes reversible depolymerization of microfilaments, not irreversible, so (D) is incorrect.  

Final answer: (C)
